description: rangeStrategy: always bump dependencies, even when the new version is already in the range.
rebaseWhen: rebase only on conflicts, to save unnecessary workflow runs.
postUpdateOptions: pnpmDedupe dedupes pnpm-lock.yaml in Renovate's own commit, so an update lands without duplicates.
internalChecksFilter: hold updates that do not yet satisfy minimumReleaseAge instead of raising a pending PR, which would run CI and fail pnpm's minimumReleaseAge policy.
ignoreDeps: ubuntu must be the oldest possible version, for binary compatibility with older operating systems.

gitIgnoredAuthors: biome-migrate.yaml commits the migrated biome.jsonc and the reformatted files to a Renovate branch as github-actions[bot]; without this, Renovate takes that commit for a manual edit, marks the pull request as edited and stops updating it.

customDatasources and the packageRules that use them: the tools that Freelens also has take the version Freelens has on main, not the newest release. See the packageRules for which ones. The custom datasources return one release, the version Freelens has, so those rules replace the current value rather than bump it: bump looks for the current version among the releases and skips a dependency with no lock file that it cannot find there.
The libraries of the generator script follow npm, not the Freelens catalog: the script runs in CI, not in Freelens.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes must not be delayed by minimumReleaseAge.

description: mise.lock pins a checksum and a URL per tool per platform, but a local `mise install` re-locks only the platform it runs on and silently leaves the other seven stale.
Lock file maintenance runs plain `mise lock`, which refreshes every tool on every platform already in the file.

Defaults are disabled and weekly, hence the explicit settings. The packageRules keep it to mise.lock, since pnpm-lock.yaml is updated with each dependency update and does not want a periodic refresh PR.

packageRules.description: No lock file maintenance by default: pnpm-lock.yaml is updated with each dependency update.
Lock file maintenance for mise.lock only.

Delay npm updates of package.json until they satisfy pnpm's minimumReleaseAge policy (1 day by default since pnpm v11). Only these land in pnpm-lock.yaml; the extension versions in extension.yaml are not installed and take no delay.

Tools run with pnpm dlx, and the Biome that Trunk runs, take the version Freelens runs with pnpm dlx in the scripts of its root package.json on main. The custom datasource has no release dates, so minimumReleaseAge is off.

The tools in mise.toml, except Node, take the versions in mise.toml of Freelens on main. The mise manager expects a leading v in the releases of tools that come from GitHub, which mise.toml does not have, so extractVersion makes it optional. The custom datasource has no release dates, so minimumReleaseAge is off.

pnpm in packageManager takes the version in mise.toml of Freelens on main, like the pnpm in mise.toml here, so the two move in one PR: pnpm switches itself to the version of packageManager, and a pnpm from mise of another version makes every CI job download pnpm a second time. The custom datasource has no release dates, so minimumReleaseAge is off.

Node stays in the 26 series rather than following Freelens, whose Node is the one bundled in Electron: the generator runs in CI, not in the app. .nvmrc, mise.toml and the Node runtime of Trunk move together in one PR; a new major is a decision of its own.
No updates of engines.node, the oldest Node the generator runs on.
Group the versions of the extensions in extension.yaml into one PR.

freelens-dlx.description: The version of a tool that a script in the root package.json of Freelens on main runs with pnpm dlx: the text after `dlx <name>@` up to the next space or the end of the script.

freelens-mise.description: The version of a tool in mise.toml of Freelens on main.

description: The npm package and its version in extension.yaml.

The fields are matched separately and combined, as other fields lie between them. Both are anchored at the start of a line, so the name of an author, an item of the indentless authors sequence, does not match.

customManagers.description: Renovate hints in a comment after the version.
